verdict.rationale: Vestd documents UK-specific schemes: qualifying EMI option scheme setup and granting, CSOPs, unapproved options and growth shares. It also has a share valuation offering, plus 409A valuations for UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers. Valuation evidence is thin (a page title only), and nothing shows plans for jurisdictions beyond the UK/US. Missing for 10: explicit HMRC/EMI valuation agreement workflow detail, country-specific option plans for non-UK international entities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, non-US valuations and schemes — UK HMRC/EMI valuations, country-specific option plans — are supported for my international entities

citations.quote: How your SME can create a qualifying EMI options scheme
